1. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/link/link.go`

issueID, err := f.ResolveIssueID(issue)

Reference for the pattern: Read `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/comment/comment.go` to see how it's done there.

The `ResolveIssueID` method is already defined on `*cmdutil.Factory` — no import changes needed.
